caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a symmetrical, heart-shaped design formed by two curved arms joining at a pointed, triangular end. The object is shown from multiple perspectives: there is a large, detailed, three-quarter view in the lower portion of the image that displays the object lying flat with three vertical cylindrical pegs protruding from three points on its frame. Above this, there is a flat, top-down view of the same object. Below the top view, a horizontal line drawing provides a side elevation that includes the projection of the three pegs downward. A simple scale is drawn next to these views for reference. The drawing is executed in shades of gray pencil on an off-white or slightly yellowed background, with careful shading to indicate the metallic texture and depth of the object. There is an artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Flatiron Holder
